name: commerce-federation
description: GraphQL Federation e-commerce platform with microservices

scripts.install:all: npm run install:gateway && npm run install:products && npm run install:users && npm run install:orders && npm run install:reviews
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:products" "npm run start:users" "npm run start:orders" "npm run start:reviews" "npm run start:gateway"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:products" "npm run dev:users" "npm run dev:orders" "npm run dev:reviews" "npm run dev:gateway"
